en: Sepia-toned multi-view postcard composed of three photographs. The top and bottom images show interiors of a traditional inn or restaurant with wooden tables and chairs, tiled stoves, mounted antlers on the walls, floral table decorations, framed pictures, and musical instruments such as guitars hanging as decor. The middle image shows the exterior of the property: a fenced rural guesthouse or inn complex with a gabled main building and a long single-storey annex, set along a cobblestone street with trees behind. Over the entrance gate there is an arched sign with faint, almost unreadable text that appears to be in a Germanic script.
